references.text: The regulations for the grain offering with fine flour mixed with oil are given here, with specific amounts for different animals (bulls, rams, lambs).
The same amounts of fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering: three-tenths for each bull and two-tenths for each ram, as at the New Moon festival.
Identical provisions for the grain offering during the Feast of Unleavened Bread: fine flour mixed with oil with the same measures for bulls and rams.
The same grain offering regulations apply at the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot): three-tenths for each bull and two-tenths for each ram.
The basic regulation for the grain offering with fine flour and oil is given here in Leviticus.
The Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot) is mentioned here, which is the context for the offerings in Numbers 29.
